intent: Technical Brief: Asus ROG Phone 8 System State Baseline
suggested_solution: Avoid purchasing the Asus ROG Phone 8 due to its high failure rate
Consider alternative options, such as Samsung or Apple phones
Use a reputable third-party repair service if you do experience issues
Take precautions to prevent overheating, such as using a good case and limiting battery charge to 80%
Consider investing in a cooling solution, such as an active cooler, to mitigate thermal throttling
